response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM group_rates) SELECT g.project_reference, g.funding_source, g.rate, g.rate - b.average_rate AS excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.average_rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
